# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple and WinUI package compatibility**

## Highlights

The next servicing release fixes Apple workload compatibility and WinUI startup for .NET 9 applications.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Apple packages accept base 26.x workloads** — Library TFMs use the base 26.0 platform version instead of 26.2, restoring native asset resolution for Avalonia Mac Catalyst applications and avoiding Uno iOS registrar and linker failures on older 26.x workloads. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
- **WinUI projection available to .NET 9** — The native projection assembly is packaged for both .NET 9 and .NET 10, fixing startup FileNotFoundException in .NET 9 applications. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
